7.7.18 Regulated DTC Counts (DM29)
The DM29 message reports the count of DTCs in each category.
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00076] ⌈On reception of request for DM29 (call of J1939Dcm_
RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according to table column
“PGN (Hexadecimal)” in [SWS_J1939Dcm_00238]) the J1939 Diagnostic Com-
munication Manager shall call for each byte in the response message the Dem_
J1939DcmSetDTCFilter with the parameters DTCStatusFilter and DTCKind as
defined in [SWS_J1939Dcm_00237].⌋
